_about: The top bar's PING readout (sidecar/TopbarPing.cs) reads this file at start. Data, not code: add a game or a region as a new set and point 'use' at it.

Each target: name (shown in the tooltip), host (a public endpoint IN or NEXT TO that data centre: never a game server, never the game's client), via (where the host is), port (TCP fallback when the host does not answer ICMP echo).

VALORANT NA (2026-10-09, lane topbar-ping): Riot runs Valorant's game servers on AWS Outposts racks plus AWS Global Accelerator, in its own chosen sites; game servers do not answer ping. The six NA locations are the ones community tools list (N. California, Oregon, Texas, Illinois, N. Virginia, Georgia). Hosts: the AWS region endpoint where an AWS region is in that place, else the Akamai/Linode speed-test host in that city (they answer ICMP for exactly this use). Measured from Owen's PC 2026-10-09: all six answer ICMP.
HARD RULE: plain network round trips to public endpoints only. Nothing here reads, touches or talks to Riot's client, its local API or Vanguard.
